description: An enterprise-grade, accessibility-first security plugin engineered by Accessible Tech Labs India. Designed for visually impaired professionals, students, and power users, this add-on acts as a silent, high-performance security guard for your system. It actively monitors your computer for newly connected USB drives and automatically neutralizes potential threats by safely ejecting or locking unauthorized drives in Read-Only mode. Featuring a smart 10-second auditory grace period (press Alt+A to whitelist), native NVDA settings integration, and one-click global unlock. The ATL USB Protector ensures your data and privacy remain 100% secure against malware and data theft directly through your screen reader environment.
